purpose: Provides the default ADR format used when a project has no ADR format of its own: file naming, structure, optional scope box, how to rewrite rejected decisions, and a template.
summary: File naming rule ADR-NNN_feature.md, one file per feature, number fixed at creation
File structure: single H1, numbered decision sections with four fixed subsections
Optional scope box with paired defined and not-defined items
How to record a rejected decision: rewrite the same section, move old option to alternatives
Template with context, decision, alternatives, and impact subsections
Guidance for writing rejection reasons with explicit premises
Impact must be evidence-based, not speculative
No metadata tables or status history sections
tasks: Reviewing an ADR for format compliance
Naming and numbering an ADR file
Rewriting a rejected or reversed decision
Deciding whether to add a scope box
title: ADR（アーキテクチャ決定記録）デフォルトフォーマット
